name: Dynamic Island
author: buildscript-dev
description: An iPhone-style Dynamic Island for Omarchy: a floating bubble in the bar that springs open for music, volume and brightness, notifications, charging, Bluetooth, timers and screen recording, with a built-in Control Center for Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sound, earbuds, tray and power.

barWidget.description: iPhone-style floating island with live activities. Reserves its space in the bar.

schema.label: Width when nothing is happening (px)
Gap between the island and the top edge (px)
Accent colors
schema.description: apple: Apple's colors (green charging, orange timer). theme: your Omarchy theme's colors.

schema.label: Open when you rest the pointer on it
How long to rest before it opens (ms)
Show new notifications in the island
Stay quiet while the phone is mirrored
schema.description: With the phone's screen mirrored on this desktop, it already shows its own notifications, messages and status, so the island does not repeat them. Calls still come through. Needs the Taildroid plugin.

schema.label: Show volume and brightness in the island
schema.description: Replaces Omarchy's own pop-up. Add "omarchy.osd" to disabledPlugins, or you get both.

schema.label: Get out of the way of fullscreen windows
Always keep the island on screen
schema.description: On: it is always there. Off: it hides when nothing is happening and slides back for music, alerts and notifications, or when you touch the top edge. Off is the look to use with the bar hidden.

schema.label: Color the music view from the album art
Orange dot while the microphone is in use
Green dot while the camera is in use
Scroll on the island to change volume
Reduce motion: no bounce, zoom or blur
Which monitor
schema.description: focused: follows the monitor you are working on. external: the external monitor, or the built-in one when nothing is plugged in. all: one island per monitor. Or a connector name such as HDMI-A-1.

schema.label: Show a clock in the island
Transcript button in the call view (the other person may need to agree to recording)
Notification width (px)
Keep windows clear of the island
Space below the island (px)
Swipe sideways on the island to tuck an activity away
Scroll down on the island for recent activity and notifications
Open to a clock and calendar card when nothing plays
Control Center on right-click
Clock format
schema.description: Qt format: HH:mm for 24-hour, h:mm AP for AM/PM.

schema.label: Island height (px)
Apple size (126 x 37)
schema.description: iPhone Pro Dynamic Island size. Overrides island width and height; the gap from the top is still pillInset.

schema.label: Tap opens the player; touch and hold expands
Dragged tiled windows float and shrink toward the island
schema.description: Super + drag upward: a tiled window is floated while you pull it toward the island and tiled again if you let go elsewhere. Turn off if a drag ever misbehaves.

schema.label: Play a sound with notifications
Soft tick on press, hold and swipe
schema.description: A desktop has no haptic motor; this plays a very short quiet click instead.

schema.label: Flash the workspace when you switch
Allow the island to use the internet
schema.description: Covers album artwork for streaming players, the weather line and the Omarchy update check. Off: the island makes no network requests at all.
